title: 2787. Ways to Express an Integer as Sum of Powers

examples.explanation: We can express n as the following: n = 32 + 12 = 10. It can be shown that it is the only way to express 10 as the sum of the 2nd power of unique integers.
We can express n in the following ways: - n = 41 = 4. - n = 31 + 11 = 4.

hints: You can use dynamic programming, where dp[k][j] represents the number of ways to express k as the sum of the x-th power of unique positive integers such that the biggest possible number we use is j.
To calculate dp[k][j], you can iterate over the numbers smaller than j and try to use each one as a power of x to make our sum k.
